images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Ranch houses

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a brand-new brick ranch photographed in snow before the lawn is in -- a fill-dirt pile and tyre ruts, a front-facing one-car garage with a panel door, a small gabled entry, a picture window, a stone accent panel

why.note: the 1950s-60s ranch: a one-storey slab house for the car-owning suburb, the garage on the front
